mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through an interaction effect.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (t-test p>0.05) when both series are above their 12-month averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness fuels corporate profit growth and reduces recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 3-month MA, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month average indicate strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized), recession risk increases, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.
